author: Legoche
body:
I have recently started my new map, but I am stuck at a very hard point: Should I continue?

Please give me your feedback, I have only built one spawn but would you play a map with this style? I am debating whether to continue work or not.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/a1DXe

Feedback, PLEASE!

It's just a spawn, I can't really tell if I'd like to play here or not. You should make some progress or atleast share a sketch of it. If you meant to ask if we'd play a map with that aesthetical design then uh I guess that doesn't matter much as long as it looks alright and pleasant to the eye.
I can't really discuss this map or give any proper feedback, much less decide if I'd want to play here or not because that's just... a spawn. Make progress and I should be able to tip you :P
